question: Can exact current-AWQ c16 retain enough L40S throughput on RTX 6000 Ada to beat $0.514/M at a sustainable all-in rate?

control.workload: exact current AWQ, vLLM 0.15.0, cache-off, 8192 input / 1024 output, c16
control.quality_claim_limit: paired diagnostic only; absolute BF16-quality failure inherited

identical: 99 KiB maximum block size in shared model
hardware_transfer.falsifier: If the exact runtime selects a different kernel, clocks throttle materially under sustained c16 load, or workstation cooling/driver behavior reduces occupancy, identical-SM transfer is not sufficient.

conservative_components.basis: same SM89 geometry and broad vLLM support; reserve 2% for runtime dispatch differences
same SM count but RTX 6000 Ada workstation cooling/TGP is not measured; low endpoint is a deliberate 10% clock/sustainance reserve
do not claim the 960/864 bandwidth advantage without a memory-counter measurement; capacity and L2 are identical
CUDA/vLLM support is broad on both; retain a small unverified-driver reserve
background service must reserve 5% at the low end for reload, interruption, retries, storage, and orchestration; upper endpoint is a non-guaranteed best case

transfer_interval.method: product of component intervals; bandwidth uplift intentionally excluded from the lower bound and upper bound because workload memory fraction is unmeasured

runpod_listing.screen: fails sustainable all-in target after lifecycle allowance; nominal listing alone passes

economics.decision: close RTX 6000 Ada placement; do not nominate a measurement

later_measurement.venue: RunPod RTX 6000 Ada only if a later authority obtains a sustainable all-in quote <= $0.813/h and exact capacity
minimal_signals: GPU identity, clocks, temperature, power, and SM utilization
memory throughput counters and L2 hit rate
request rows, aggregate output tok/s, TTFT/TPOT, failures and interruption/reload time
